settings.q: Do the magnets go inside my nose?
settings.a: No. The magnets sit on the outside of your nose, held by the adhesive strip. Nothing goes inside.

settings.q: Will the strip stay on overnight — even if I sweat?
settings.a: Yes. The adhesive is made to hold through heat, humidity and movement.

settings.q: How is Noctara different from regular nasal strips?
settings.a: Regular strips use a plastic spring that pulls your skin outward. Noctara uses magnets that lift your nostrils open from the sides.

settings.q: I already breathe pretty well. Would this still help?
settings.a: Many people don’t notice how blocked they are until their airway is fully open. Try it for 30 nights risk-free.
The adhesive is gentle and latex-free. With sensitive skin, test one strip for a few hours before wearing it overnight. If you have known adhesive allergies, email us before ordering.

settings.q: Can I use Noctara while exercising?
settings.a: Yes. Many people wear it for workouts, runs and rides.
The magnets are reusable. The adhesive strips are single-use for hygiene. Refills ship separately.

settings.q: Will this change the shape of my nose?
settings.a: No. Noctara gently lifts the soft tissue of your nostrils. When you take it off, your nose goes straight back to normal.
